# Code Anchors: Publishing Config Resolution

- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-shared/delivery_config.py` — the single shared resolver: config reading through the one github-block key map (the block's single schema), the classification/project/repo-target resolvers, the record-label/record-type and needs-design/in-progress label resolvers with hub fall-through, the precedence chain, the hub-defaults reader, and the GitHub helpers it centralizes.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-shared/test_delivery_config.py` — unit coverage for every resolver: precedence order, the three classification modes, project target keywords, epic/story repo specificity, hub-defaults inheritance, and the record/design-gate keys.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-shared/test_needs_design_label.py` — coverage for the design-warrant threshold and the needs-design/in-progress label resolution.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-create-epic/scripts/nxs_gh_create_epic.py` — the epic-filing consumer: imports the resolver instead of carrying its own copy, resolves the epic's target repo, classification, and project, and upserts labels before applying them.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-create-story/scripts/create_gh_issues.py` — the story-filing consumer: imports the same resolver and resolves the story target repo, classification, and project through it.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-create-epic/SKILL.md` — documents the epic-filing skill's resolved inputs and the epic label default.
- `.claude/skills/nxs-gh-create-story/SKILL.md` — documents the story-filing skill's resolved inputs.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.close.md` — a stage consumer: resolves the epic's repo once through the shared resolver and threads it onto every issue operation.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — the epic-resolver consumer: reads the classification mode and record marker across a process seam, never parsing settings itself.
- `libs/workspace/src/manifest.ts` — validates and carries the optional workspace-wide publishing-defaults block that forms this resolver's hub layer.
- `libs/workspace/src/resolve.ts` — carries those defaults through onto the resolved workspace description.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the read-out verb that emits the hub defaults as machine-readable output, the cross-language seam this resolver reads them across.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workspace-github-defaults.spec.ts` — covers that read-out's behavior, including the empty result on a single-repo checkout and on a resolution failure.
- `.nexus/config/templates/workspace-template.yml` — documents the optional workspace-wide defaults block, its allowed keys, per-key inheritance, and the no-code-repo targeting case.
